summary: Requested a revision of experiment 94c20e41b2ad4cfba9d46911ecede913-experiment that repairs the one definition defect in its first receipt. Comparison 0 asserted add_failed on the result event while the harness emitted that field only on the case event, so the receipt evaluates it as unknown ('Missing required result fields: add_failed'). The harness now emits add_failed on the result event as well; the cluster, the injected failure, the partitions, the event names, the prerequisites and all six comparisons are unchanged, and previous_id plus revision_reason record the lineage, so the new receipt is directly comparable with the first. Re-executing also supplies a second observation of the decisive case. In the first receipt the leader was A with committed peer B; a local run of the revised harness reproduced the pair with the roles swapped (leader B, committed peer A: re-elected, commit_index=4, new server at 4, committed peer at 2; control without the new server: no re-election, no commit), and both result events now carry add_failed true. The submission validates against submission.schema.json with zero errors and requests one execution.
